tone: warm, communal, humble, Christ-centered, persuasive without manipulation
target_reader: religion-naive adults and older adolescents near grade 6
translation_identity: firmly dynamic-equivalence, NLT-like in readability but independent
governing_rules: The prose serves the reader; the apparatus serves accountability.
Translate meaning, logic, tone, and theological force rather than Greek surface form.
Use clear natural oral English; reorder, split, unpack, and clarify implied relationships when comprehension benefits.
Do not add commentary or meaning not defensible from Greek and context.
No comparison translations or benchmark wording may enter blind drafting.
existing_decisions: Render euangelion accessibly as good news where context supports it.
For mixed-congregation adelphoi, normally use brothers and sisters while preserving the family metaphor.
Render masculine generics according to intended meaning.
Maintain the reader-first dynamic center established by the audited Philippians 1 benchmark without exposing its wording to blind workers.

units.title: A unified life shaped by Christ
known_issues: Verse 1 uses a rhetorical conditional sequence whose force is assumed reality, not uncertainty.
κοινωνία πνεύματος may refer to fellowship created by or participation in the Spirit; avoid prematurely collapsing the ambiguity.
Verse 2 coordinates same mind, same love, shared life, and common purpose without demanding personality uniformity.
ἐριθεία and κενοδοξία require natural renderings of selfish rivalry and empty self-importance.
Verse 3 asks believers to regard others above themselves without implying that others possess greater intrinsic worth.
Verse 4 contrasts exclusive self-concern with active attention to others; it does not forbid legitimate personal responsibility.

verses.greek: Εἴ τις οὖν παράκλησις ἐν Χριστῷ εἴ τι παραμύθιον ἀγάπης εἴ τις κοινωνία πνεύματος εἴ τις σπλάγχνα καὶ οἰκτιρμοί
πληρώσατέ μου τὴν χαρὰν ἵνα τὸ αὐτὸ φρονῆτε τὴν αὐτὴν ἀγάπην ἔχοντες σύμψυχοι τὸ ἓν φρονοῦντες
μηδὲν κατ’ ἐριθείαν μηδὲ κατὰ κενοδοξίαν ἀλλὰ τῇ ταπεινοφροσύνῃ ἀλλήλους ἡγούμενοι ὑπερέχοντας ἑαυτῶν
μὴ τὰ ἑαυτῶν ἕκαστοι σκοποῦντες ἀλλὰ καὶ τὰ ἑτέρων ἕκαστοι
